standby-refresh-catchup.about: Owner's first real class (card q9590 A). Refreshes the Postgres standby from GREYWOLF if the last good refresh is over 24 h old and GREYWOLF answers. It is an existing script on overlord that cron runs every 2 h at :17; the router runs the same script, it does not replace it. GREYWOLF is a source, not a place: the class must wait until the feed shows it up on fresh facts. argv and timeout_s are TAKEN ON TRUST from the NODE fleet handoff of 2026-11-17 and were not read on overlord: confirm the path, and that six hours is longer than a real refresh, before the cron line is switched.
